import math
anchor=next(pts for v,b,pts in components if v==1 and len(pts)>1)
cy=sum(r for r,c in anchor)/len(anchor);cx=sum(c for r,c in anchor)/len(anchor)
arr=[]
for v,b,pts in components:
 if pts==anchor:continue
 yy=sum(r for r,c in pts)/len(pts);xx=sum(c for r,c in pts)/len(pts)
 d=math.hypot(cy-yy,cx-xx)
 # nearest Manhattan gap
 dm=min(abs(r-r2)+abs(c-c2) for r,c in anchor for r2,c2 in pts)
 arr.append((round(d,2),dm,v,len(pts),b))
